applies_why: The judge text decides whether the cited-in verses for D2 vs C3 count as unanswered witnesses, which is the matter K-G4 governs.
quote: the "witness left unanswered" ground fails and the collision is regraded UNDERDETERMINED
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round
why: K-G4 only limits when a verse may be counted as an unanswered witness, and the judge text declines to count them, withdrawing the unanswered-witness ground and regrading the item, so it does not do what the rule forbids.
